high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "alone_tales." The post features a close-up photograph of a person's shoulder with three snake tattoos. The snakes are intricately designed, with detailed scales and a realistic appearance. The background is plain and neutral, likely to emphasize the tattoo. The text overlay on the image reads: "Sometimes you have show people your bad side to let them realize you was real all the time." This quote suggests a theme of vulnerability and authenticity.
